executive_summary: This skill provides a comprehensive toolkit for programmatic video creation using Remotion and React. It introduces several risks related to dynamic data injection and state manipulation, which could be exploited by attackers to inject malicious content or manipulate the agent's behavior.
skill_purpose_analysis: The skill is designed to facilitate the creation of dynamic videos using Remotion and React. While it offers extensive functionality, its reliance on dynamic data inputs makes it susceptible to injection attacks and state manipulation.
remediation_priority: Prioritize validating and sanitizing all dynamic data inputs to prevent injection attacks and state manipulation.

vulnerabilities.title: Dynamic Data Injection
vulnerabilities.affected_content: npx remotion render src/index.ts MyComposition out.mp4 --props '{"title": "Hello"}'
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill allows dynamic data injection via the --props flag, which could be exploited to inject malicious content.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could craft a malicious payload in the --props argument to execute arbitrary code or manipulate the video generation process.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize all user-provided data before passing it to the --props flag.

vulnerabilities.title: Memory Poisoning via Dynamic Data
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Pass dynamic data to the --props flag
vulnerabilities.explanation: If the skill writes user-provided data directly into persistent memory without validation, it could lead to memory poisoning.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could inject malicious data into the --props flag, which could then be stored in persistent memory and affect future operations.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sanitize and validate all data before storing it in persistent memory.

vulnerabilities.title: State Manipulation via Dynamic Data
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Pass dynamic data to the --props flag
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill's ability to accept dynamic data could be exploited to manipulate the agent's internal state.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker could inject malicious data into the --props flag to alter the agent's behavior or decision-making process.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict validation and sanitization of all dynamic data inputs.
